extractedItems.question: If you play your ball from the wrong tee, which rule applies?

choices.text: It's fine as long as the shot was good.
The same rule applies as when playing from outside the teeing area.
You must retake the shot with no penalty.
You get a prize for being creative.

extractedItems.explanation: If you play from the wrong tee, the same rule applies as when playing from outside the teeing area.

Yes, but only if it's raining.

reviewedItems.title: Playing from the wrong teeing area
reviewedItems.question: If you play your ball from the wrong teeing area, what is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You can continue playing your ball with no penalty if the shot was good.
You must cancel your shot and play again from the correct teeing area, with a penalty.
You must retake the shot without any penalty.
You receive a reward for being original.

reviewedItems.explanation: If you play from the wrong teeing area, your shot does not count. In stroke play, you must cancel the shot, play from the correct teeing area, and add a two-stroke penalty.

reviewedItems.imageAlt: A teen golfer addressing a ball outside the proper teeing area, with tee-markers in view.

choices.text: Yes, there is no penalty for moving them.
No, moving them to gain an advantage results in a two stroke penalty.
Only if all players agree.
Yes, but only if it is raining.

reviewedItems.explanation: You must not move the tee-markers to improve your position. If you do, you receive a two-stroke penalty in stroke play.

Pulling up loose grass that might affect your shot.

Moving the tee-markers to change your starting spot.
